subject: general
question: The word Manuscripts derived from which of the following language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Latin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word manuscript is derived from the medieval **Latin **usage ‘**manu**’ meaning ‘**by hand**’ and ‘**scribere**’ means ‘**to write**’. Thus, any book or document written by hand is called a manuscript.
 
• Manuscripts are **sources of human history** available in various kinds of media like stones,

 clay tablets, palm leaves, metal leaves, bark, animal skin, cloth, paper, etc
 
• Most of the manuscripts were written in **Sanskrit**, **Prakrit **and **Tamil **language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fd71d15d26d6e16b71acb8d7c6bb2c938431d78305b9bcefb5f281f1301d7ad.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manuscripts **were written on varied subjects such as religious beliefs and practices, the lives of kings, medicine, and science. Besides, there were epics, poems, musical dance dramas and plays.
 
• **India possesses an estimated five million manuscripts**, probably the largest collection in the world.
 
• The **Spitzer **Manuscripts are the oldest surviving philosophical manuscripts in Sanskrit.
 
• The oldest manuscripts in the world are in the **Pseudo-Apulelus Herbarium**, dating back to the 6-7th century.
